verified: The FCC published an authorization on Wednesday for up to 1 million Starmind satellites, with a 2033 first-satellite milestone and a 2040 full-constellation milestone, and FCC Chairman Brendan Carr issued a statement calling it a "bold new frontier" for computing infrastructure.
unconfirmed: whether satellites of this kind can be built, launched and operated at that scale or cost — no Starmind satellite has flown, and the Q3 2027 first launch is SpaceX's stated aim, not an FCC requirement; the conditions the FCC attached beyond the two milestones, and how its deferred ruling on graveyard-orbit disposal will be resolved, are not detailed in these accounts.

verified: FCC 于11月25日发布公告，给予 SpaceX 有条件授权，可部署最多100万颗 Starmind 卫星；Carr 的声明以及2033年至少一颗、2040年100万颗的里程碑要求均出自 FCC 公开文件，路透社、Ars Technica、The Verge 与 Space.com 的报道在这些数字上一致。
unconfirmed: 100万颗这一规模在工程、发射成本与轨道安全上是否可行，报道未提供独立评估；SpaceX 所称“2027年第三季度发射首批卫星”是公司目标而非已排定的发射；FCC 同时推迟了 SpaceX 关于将600公里以上卫星送入“墓地轨道”处置的请求，相关离轨规则尚未确定。

titles.en: FCC conditionally authorizes SpaceX's 1-million-satellite Starmind constellation
titles.zh: FCC 批准 SpaceX 部署100万颗“Starmind”太空数据中心卫星
